bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 10 inches by 10 inches are not allowed. Backpacks, CamelBaks and bota bags are also prohibited.
bagPolicy.quote: NO LARGE BAGS OVER 10″ X 10″, BACKPACKS, CAMELBACKS, OR BOTA BAGS.

parking.summary: Knuckleheads has 3 dedicated parking lots just west of the venue and 1 more on the east side of the building.
parking.quote: Our venue has 3 dedicated parking lots just to the west of us and 1 more on the east of the building.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Knuckleheads. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The bar is cash only, though Knuckleheads gift cards work at select bars, and credit cards are accepted at the Kitchen and Gift Shop. Outside food and drinks are not allowed, including cans, bottles, coolers and empty water bottles.
concessions.quote: NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINKS, INCLUDING CANS, BOTTLES, COOLERS, AND EMPTY WATER BOTTLES.

accessibility.summary: Knuckleheads is wheelchair accessible, and some tables are ADA friendly. The venue is not dog friendly, so call (816) 483-1456 ahead if you plan to bring a service animal.
accessibility.quote: Our venue is wheelchair accessible and some tables are ADA friendly.

reEntry.summary: Knuckleheads hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is usually open Wednesday to Friday 7pm to 10pm, Saturday 12pm to 10pm and Sunday 12pm to 6pm, and is closed Monday and Tuesday unless there's a concert; times may vary. Credit cards are accepted for tickets online, at the box office and at the door, and will call name changes go through the box office. Shows are 21+, ages 10 to 20 may attend with a parent or guardian, and children under 10 are not admitted.
ticketPickup.quote: 21 + (Under 21 and 10 or older are allowed with a parent or guardian)

gates.summary: Doors generally open at 7pm or 1 hour before showtime, and can be delayed by sound check. Check your ticket or the event listing for that night's times.
gates.quote: Doors generally open at 7:00 pm or 1 hour before showtime.
